newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer wants to partner Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Placer wants to partner Bre-X.

text.p: Vancouver-based mining giant Placer Dome said on Monday it wants formally to submit an offer to partner Bre-X and the Indonesian government in the rich Busang gold discovery.

Placer said in a letter to the Indonesian consulate general in Toronto that it had held discussions with Bre-X about a partnership. But the talks were pre-empted by the Indonesian government's directive to Bre-X to negotiate a deal with Barrick Gold Corp and conclude an agreement by December 4.
Bre-X and Barrick's shares have been extraordinarily volatile in the run-up to the December 4 deadline amid a swirl of rumors about the Indonesian deal.
Analysts noted on Monday that Bre-X appeared to have little room to manouevre in the talks with Barrick as it was given no choice of partners by the Indonesian government.
Bre-X has been plagued by rumors since it announced this fall that it was searching for a heavyweight partner to help it develop and mine the Busang deposit.

"Placer Dome has been in discussions with Bre-X and their advisors since March 1996 regarding an offer to develop the Busang deposit," Placer's Franklin said in the letter. "These negotiations have been recently pre-empted by the actions of Barrick. Placer Dome is prepared to make an offer, and is fully qualified to develop this property."
